<!--
  The application CV for training roles at national statistical offices — teaching
  statistics and R to the staff of statistical offices in southern Africa and
  comparable posts.

  It differs from its siblings in more than one paragraph. Bukin-cv-general.qmd and
  Bukin-cv-JRC-tax-2026.qmd are cv-full.qmd with a different About; this one reorders
  the CV and rewrites the employer entries, because the reader is buying a teacher of
  statistics rather than a researcher:

    - Education comes BEFORE experience. The statistics training is the credential
      here, and the Erasmus Mundus place line names Pretoria.
    - Teaching and training is a section of its own, above experience, and mixes
      university courses with counterpart training. That is the whole of what this CV
      does differently with teaching: the ENTRIES are the ones in ../_cv.yml, read by
      a call with no `from=`, because the words were never what had to change. An
      earlier version of this file kept a reworded copy of them in
      ../_cv-r-training.yml and the two drifted; see that file's header.
    - The employer entries are rewritten rather than reselected, and therefore come
      from a second record, ../_cv-r-training.yml, via `from=r-training`. FAO leads
      with official statistics, JLU with five years of teaching, IAMO with survey data
      collection. See that file's header for why `in:` could not do this.
    - R packages and tools is printed here and in no other CV: for this audience the
      packages are the evidence behind the R claim.
    - Scholarships are dropped, to keep the whole thing to about three pages.

  Every call WITHOUT `from=` still reads ../_cv.yml and ../_publications.yml — the
  teaching entries, the education entries, the software entries, the languages and
  every publication — so a correction to the record reaches this CV too. Like its
  siblings it states no fact about the person.

  Its header asks for private=true, so it carries the contact details the website does
  not publish — location, nationality, phone, email — read from ../_cv-private.yml,
  which is gitignored. Without that file the line is simply left out, which is what
  happens in CI.

  The file is named for the PDF it becomes, Bukin-cv-R-training-NSO.pdf: that PDF goes
  out as an attachment as it is, so the source carries the name the attachment should.

  It is built by every render, like its siblings, and lands in ../_site/cv/. It is not
  published: the deploy step in ../.github/workflows/publish.yml deletes every PDF in
  _site/cv/ except cv-full.pdf and cv-short.pdf before uploading the site.
-->
